title: Component
description: A single spawnable game object definition, including its model, transform, physics, snap points, scripts, and arbitrary properties.

id.description: Stable, unique identifier for this component. Used as the lookup key in the registry.

description.description: Optional description shown in UI or debug output.

version.description: Semantic version string for schema evolution tracking.

model.description: Asset path or GUID of the 3D model (mesh) to spawn.

transform.description: Initial transform applied when the component is spawned.

spawnOffset.description: Local-space offset composited at spawn time, after the stored transform.

snappoints.description: Snap point definitions — individual, grid, or mixed.

scripts.description: Script bindings evaluated at load/spawn time.

collider.description: Collision shape definition. String = named preset (e.g. 'box', 'sphere', 'mesh'); object = detailed config.

freezePosition.description: [x, y, z] freeze axes for position.

freezeRotation.description: [x, y, z] freeze axes for rotation.

tags.description: Arbitrary string tags used for filtering, snap compatibility, or scripting.

properties.description: Freeform key-value store forwarded to scripts as the component's property table.

inherits.description: ID of another component to inherit defaults from. Explicit fields override inherited values.

enabled.description: When false, the loader skips this component entirely.
